reason: Observed stationary foregrounds themselves raise per-window gain CV, so event-time thresholding is confounded. Development background calibration means separate stationary (0.061-0.068), slow (0.167-0.195) and fast (0.545-0.572).
frozen_rule: Mean coefficient of variation of smoothed common band level over first three unlabelled warmup clips, dropping first three gain time constants of each clip. Enable compensation if mean >=0.12; otherwise preserve raw power. Choice freezes after calibration. No simulation condition labels or event truth enter learner.
warmup: Raw power feeds the original background estimator in both modes during initial calibration; profile and CV are collected in parallel.
matrix: Same six controlled modulation cells, -6 dB before channel, 120 windows
metrics: Affected streams, false prototypes, false attention, localized detection/identity with three IoU thresholds, overlap controls and paired uncertainty. Report compensation decisions, not just outcomes.
limits: Assumes calibration represents subsequent environment. Mid-run changes, silence, contaminated startup, and recordings remain separate requirements. Not an oracle condition switch or proof of field robustness.
